business.name: Elements Sushi
business.notes: The project owner confirms Elements Sushi had closed at 80 Clapham High Street by the photograph on 2026-04-03. The exact final trading day is unknown. This Is Clapham's article https://www.thisisclapham.co.uk/elements-sushi-arrives-in-clapham/ announces the Clapham restaurant had opened following success at its Streatham branch. The page gives an initial publication date of 2024-07-03 and an updated date of 2024-07-19 (checked 2026-10-29). The publication date is not an established opening day. is_chain = 1 records the Clapham and Streatham branches described in this contemporary source, not a claim that either was trading on the photograph date. No standalone website or social profile has been supplied or verified.
